riskTip.high: High risk: moving this may affect system stability
riskTip.medium: Medium risk: close the app before moving

moved.emptyDesc: Pick a target drive in “Applications” to move an app. Every move is recorded here and can be restored at any time.
moved.summary_one: {{count}} app moved · about {{size}} freed from C:
moved.summary_other: {{count}} apps moved · about {{size}} freed from C:
moved.restoreTip: Move the app back to its original location

dialog.stepDriveEmpty: No other fixed drive was detected. Please connect the target disk first.
dialog.modeDefaultDesc: Creates a FolderMove-Plus folder at the root of the target drive and moves the app into it. One step, good enough for 99% of cases.
dialog.modeAdvancedDesc: Opens the built-in file manager so you can pick the exact destination folder. Supports creating and renaming folders for fine-grained organisation.
dialog.pickdirHint: {{name}} will be created inside the selected folder
dialog.noSubfoldersHint: You can use the current folder as the destination, or click “New folder” above
dialog.highRiskFallback: This path is part of the system, moving it may break Windows or the app.
dialog.highRiskSuffix: Create a restore point and fully close the related apps first.
dialog.spaceEnough: Enough space. Moving this is expected to free {{size}}
dialog.spaceNotEnough: Not enough free space on the target drive ({{free}} < {{size}})
dialog.procsFound_one: {{count}} leftover process is still using this folder
dialog.procsFound_other: {{count}} leftover processes are still using this folder
dialog.procsFoundHint: If you have already closed the app, these may be processes that did not exit cleanly.
dialog.procsNone: No leftover process found, safe to move

progress.doneHint: You can now work on other apps
progress.runningHint: Do not close the app or cut the power

toast.procKillPartial: Some processes could not be terminated: {{list}}

error.sameDrive: Source and target are on the same drive, nothing to move
error.insufficientSpace: Not enough free space on the target drive: {{needed}} bytes needed, {{available}} bytes available
error.alreadyLinked: The source folder is already a link and cannot be moved again: {{path}}

copyFailedDetail.robocopyExitCode: robocopy exit code {{code}} (≥8 means some files failed — they may be in use, close the app first)

error.verifyFailed: Copy finished but verification failed: target is {{size}} bytes, source is about {{expected}} bytes — the copy is incomplete
error.renameFailed: Failed to rename the source folder; the app may be running or files are in use: {{detail}}
error.recordNotFound: No move record found with id {{id}}
error.restoreNotLink: Original path {{path}} is not a link — it may have been changed manually, so it cannot be restored automatically
error.targetEmpty: The copy at {{path}} is empty, so the restore was cancelled to avoid wiping the app. Check that folder, or copy the files back manually.
error.cleanupFailed: Restore finished, but the copy at {{path}} could not be deleted ({{detail}}). Something is probably holding the folder open — close File Explorer or your antivirus and delete it manually.
error.localAppDataMissing: Cannot read the LOCALAPPDATA environment variable
error.parentMustBeAbsolute: The parent folder must be an absolute path: {{path}}
error.oldPathMustBeAbsolute: The original path must be absolute: {{path}}
error.newFolderNameEmpty: New folder name cannot be empty
error.folderNameExists: A folder with the same name already exists: {{path}}

reason.dirMissing: Folder does not exist or is not accessible
reason.alreadyLinked: This folder is already a link and may have been moved before
reason.alreadyJunction: Already a junction link, no need to move it again
reason.systemCritical: Critical system folder — moving it may affect system stability, please be careful
reason.driverOrRuntime: Driver or runtime library that other software depends on — moving it may break those apps
reason.systemInstallDir: Located in a system-level install folder; moving requires administrator rights, close the app first
reason.userDir: Located in a user folder, low risk to move

progressMessage.cleaningTarget: Cleaning up the copy on the target drive…
